title: Cloud syndication onboarding checklist - WIP
checklist_items: Collect publisher metadata: product name, short blurb (<=140 chars), long description (<=1200 chars), logos (SVG + PNG 1x/2x), hero screenshot
Determine SKU mapping for cloud vendors (AWS/Azure/GCP): map Redwood plans to marketplace SKUs and pricing tiers
Confirm billing model: metered per-token vs fixed monthly seat vs reserved capacity SKU
Prepare one-click deployment assets: Terraform module, ARM template, GCP deployment manager snippet
Create quickstart script & sample app: minimal Node/Python demo calling Redwood hosted API and Dedicated fallback example
Security/compliance pack: SOC2 summary, encryption-at-rest statement, KMS/HSM integration notes, regional data residency options
Collect licensing/legal artifacts: EULA draft for marketplace, export control checklist, partner agreement summary
Packaging assets: marketing blurb variants, 1-line taglines, hero banner copy, 3 feature bullets, customer logos / reference case (permissioned)
SLA & support: define support tiers, escalation matrix, response SLOs for marketplace customers
Integration tests: validate listing UI metadata, purchase flow end-to-end (test accounts), provisioning automation
Vendor console requirements: admin UI screenshots, entitlement controls, admin API endpoints for provisioning
Observability / telemetry: list of metrics surfaced to partner portals (latency P95, token consumption, error-rate), and recommended retention
Create FAQ draft for listing: security, billing, cancellation, data retention, private deployment options
Determine marketplace-specific features: e.g., private offers, reserved capacity mapping, reseller flows
Translate copy for DE/FR/JP locales for target regions (placeholder translations acceptable for initial submission)
Run legal risk review and export control signoff (attach signed checklist)
acceptance_criteria: Metadata correctly rendered in vendor UI (no truncation), verified by QA
Purchase flow completes and provisions either hosted account or Dedicated trial, validated on staging accounts
Billing mapping works: metered usage reported to vendor billing API, sample invoice generated
Security pack uploaded and links in listing available to reviewers
One-click deploy artifacts pass linting and provisioning tests in each cloud region listed
Support escalation doc accepted by GTM and SRE on-call rotation owners
Marketing copy approved by brand and legal (track signoffs)
Listing passes vendor preflight checklist for 1st marketplace submission
draft_notes: Working assumptions: initial SKU will be 'Redwood Hosted - Standard' (metered tokens) + 'Redwood Dedicated - Starter' (monthly commit). Need legal to confirm revenue recognition implications.
Open question: Should private deployment (VPC/on-prem) be a separate SKU or a consult/service add-on? Pros/cons listed below.
Decision log: preferring meter-first approach for PLG funnel; Dedicated SKUs reserved for enterprise conversions after usage threshold
Slack threads: @liam started a thread with AWS marketplace SME (see linked_artifacts). Waiting on sample billing integration snippet from infra.
Risk: some customers require pre-provisioned CloudFormation stacks with specific tagging; include tags in template and test tagging pipeline
Notes-to-self: extract short blurb alternative for A/B test in vendor UI - 2 variants: emphasis on latency/cost vs flexibility/controls
Localization: prioritize German and Japanese for EU/APAC partners; get translation vendor estimate
GovCloud: build separate listing for US GovCloud if requested—this will need separate security attestation
Telemetry: vendor portals often limit custom metrics; prepare fallback mapping to vendor's standard metrics
Edge case: reseller flow that bundles Redwood with partner-managed infra — need contract template and billing passthrough flow
marketplace_copy_snippets:
Short blurb (140 chars): 'High-performance LLM inference with predictable costs — hosted, dedicated, or private deployments.'
Alternate tagline: 'Ship LLM features fast. Keep costs low. Control where data lives.'
Feature bullets (270 chars each):
- 'Multi-mode inference: hosted API for fast onboarding, reserved Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput, and Private deployments for regulated workloads.'
- 'Cost controls: intelligent batching, caching, and quantization profiles to reduce per-token cost without sacrificing quality.'
- 'Operational visibility: per-request cost/latency breakdowns, rollouts, and automatic fallbacks to keep apps online.'

Create short testimonial (ask legal for permission) — target: 3 customers

sample_ux_notes: Vendor listing typically shows: logo, display name, rating, short blurb, 3 bullets, pricing model picker, 'Get started' CTA, and additional tabs (Overview, Support, Documentation). For 'Get started' — wire to quickstart that auto-provisions trial keys and shows usage dashboard. Include 'Contact sales' conditional when user selects Dedicated/Private SKU.
notes_for_engineering: Provisioning endpoints must support idempotent calls and return a human-friendly status URL. Provide sample webhook payload for provisioning succeeded/failed. Include example API key rotation guidance for marketplace-provisioned keys.
unresolved_questions: Marketplace tax handling: does vendor handle tax or do we need to include tax in listed price?
How to handle free-tier credits vs vendor credit policies?
Do we include a trial duration default for Dedicated (30 days?) or require sales handoff immediately?
